links.outcome: Expert-rated quality and safety violations of graph-grounded LLM answers on complex inference queries
links.effect: Complex inference tasks achieved a mean expert quality score of 4.25/5 with zero safety violations; 100% recall for factual queries. No ungrounded baseline reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Complex inference tasks achieved a mean expert quality score of 4.25/5 with zero safety violations across all evaluated cases.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid graph RAG combining Text2Cypher structured retrieval with vector search for EHR question answering

screen.reason: Evaluates a hybrid Graph RAG system (MediGRAF) designed to ground LLMs on EHR data to mitigate hallucinations and safety violations, using expert clinical evaluation on MIMIC-IV patient records.
